query: TCFD 披露 TCFD 披露 衡量企业气候信息披露与TCFD四大支柱（治理、战略、风险管理、指标与目标）的契合程度。 重点考察：披露完整性、可比性、可核验性。 一、内容质量得分 (权重 50%，0-4分) • 2分：四大支柱完整披露，指标/目标清晰，边界、方法、假设透明，信息可追溯。 • 1分：仅覆盖部分支柱，披露深度有限。 • 0分：无 TCFD 相关披露。 二、覆盖应用得分 (权重 50%，0-4分) • 2分：披露覆盖 >80% 业务实体/合并范围。 • 1分：覆盖 20% - 50%。 • 0分：无有效覆盖信息。 最终得分 = 0.5×内容质量+0.5×覆盖应用 TCFD 气候相关财务披露 治理支柱 战略支柱 风险管理支柱 指标与目标 TCFD索引 气候信息披露对照 ISSB IFRS S2 TCFD Task Force on Climate-related Financial Disclosures climate-related financial disclosures governance pillar strategy pillar risk management pillar metrics and targets TCFD index climate disclosure alignment ISSB IFRS S2 报告是否明确按TCFD或等价气候披露框架组织信息？ 治理、战略、风险管理、指标与目标四大支柱是否均有披露？ 指标、目标、边界、方法或假设是否可追溯？ 披露覆盖了哪些业务实体或合并范围？ 是否提供TCFD索引表或支柱对照？
instruction: Assess whether the passage provides concrete evidence for the ESG indicator 'TCFD 披露'. Prefer explicit, auditable disclosure that answers: 报告是否明确按TCFD或等价气候披露框架组织信息？ 治理、战略、风险管理、指标与目标四大支柱是否均有披露？ 指标、目标、边界、方法或假设是否可追溯？ 披露覆盖了哪些业务实体或合并范围？ 是否提供TCFD索引表或支柱对照？ Exclude or down-rank: 排除：仅单点披露物理风险或转型风险而无框架映射；仅有减排目标而无治理/战略/风险管理支柱；仅提及“参考TCFD”而无实质内容；仅有场景分析而无整体支柱覆盖；区分：TCFD披露评估四大支柱整体契合与可核验性；物理/转型风险与场景分析分别是支柱下的专题内容，单独专题充分不等于TCFD整体披露充分。注意：原关键词曾误用转型风险词表，已按TCFD框架重写。 Preserve relevant tables, notes, units, limitations, policies, targets, methods and coverage details.

results.text: Regulators in Hong Kong are actively driving climate-related disclosure and strengthening relevant requirements. The Green and Sustainable Finance Cross-Agency Steering Group requires institutions of the financial services sector to make financial disclosures recommended by the Task Force on Climate-Related Financial Disclosures ('TCFD') by 2025. The SEHK has formulated the Guidance on Climate Disclosure for listed companies based on the recommendations of the TCFD to help the companies take action to tackle climate change, effectively manage both opportunities and risks related to climate change, and facilitate a smooth transition to a more sustainable, lower-carbon economy.
results.retrieval_text:
[Section]
Governance / Climate-related Financial Disclosure Recommendations

[Content]
Regulators in Hong Kong are actively driving climate-related disclosure and strengthening relevant requirements. The Green and Sustainable Finance Cross-Agency Steering Group requires institutions of the financial services sector to make financial disclosures recommended by the Task Force on Climate-Related Financial Disclosures ('TCFD') by 2025. The SEHK has formulated the Guidance on Climate Disclosure for listed companies based on the recommendations of the TCFD to help the companies take action to tackle climate change, effectively manage both opportunities and risks related to climate change, and facilitate a smooth transition to a more sustainable, lower-carbon economy.

The Group established an environmental, social and governance task force and a working group in April 2022 to implement the Group's environmental, social and governance initiatives and to ensure comprehensive coverage of the environmental, social and governance initiatives of the Group. Feature Stories / Feature Story 1

[Content]
The '14 th Five-Year Plan for Building Energy Conservation and Green Building Development' issued by the Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development sets development goals for the nation's construction industry. By 2025, all new buildings in urban areas will be fully constructed as green building. More than 50 million square meters of ultra-low energy and near-zero energy buildings will be built. Prefabricated buildings shall account for 30% of new urban buildings of the year. The installed capacity of solar photovoltaics in new buildings will be more than 50 million kilowatts. The application area of geothermal buildings will be more than 100 million square meters, and the replacement rate of renewable energy in urban buildings will reach 8%. The proportion of electricity consumption in building energy consumption is more than 55%. With these goals, a green, low-carbon, and circular construction and development mode will be formed, and a solid foundation will be laid for carbon peaking in urban and rural construction by 2030.

[Content]
During the Reporting Year, the Group conducted a materiality review to understand the sustainability issues of concern to stakeholders. This not only helps the Group further understand its operation situation, but also guides the Group to formulate proactive and targeted implementation plans. The materiality review adopted a combination of qualitative and quantitative assessments to identify the latest issues related to sustainable development trends in addition to existing material issues. The Group identified and defined twenty-one sustainability issues and megatrends related to the real estate industry, covering environmental protection, employment and labour practices, operating practices, community and innovation. Stakeholders from different business sectors were invited to interviews to understand their views on issues and establish sustainability strategies. Besides, through questionnaire surveys, Board members and employees were invited to rank various issues according to their perceived importance to the business and stakeholders. Based on the opinions of different parties, the following seven important sustainable development issues of the Group were sorted out and approved by the Board and the Executive Committee.
